tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Live USD prices and 24-hour changes from CoinGecko. Pass tickers as a comma-separated string, for example BTC,ETH,SOL. CoinGecko ids such as bitcoin also work. Free, no payment.

tools.name: fear_greed
tools.description: Current Crypto Fear & Greed Index (0-100) from alternative.me. Free, no payment.

tools.name: top_movers
tools.description: Biggest 24-hour gainers and losers from CoinGecko's top 250 by market cap. Coins under min_volume_usd, with a tiny volume-to-market-cap ratio, or with an extreme move on low liquidity are marked suspicious and, by default, listed in filtered_out instead of the headline lists. tools.name: rug_risk
tools.description: Rug-pull / honeypot score from 0 to 100 using GoPlus, DexScreener, and RugCheck on Solana. chain is ethereum, bsc, base, or solana (eth, bnb, and sol also work). Trusted tokens still list issuer-style flags but those flags do not add points. include_summary adds an InferHub paragraph. Paid tool: $0.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "market_brief" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
